message.content:
Looking at the task, I need to create `configs/navil_9b.yaml` following the same structure as `configs/navil_2b.yaml` but with NaViL-9B specific values from the paper (Table 6, Table 8) and the design specification.

Key differences from NaViL-2B:
- Visual encoder: depth=32, width=1792, mlp_width=7168, num_heads=28, params=1.2B
- LLM: Qwen3-8B, depth=36, width=4096, mlp_width=12288, num_heads=32
- S1.1: steps=50000, batch=10300, visual_multiscale=False (disabled for acceleration)
- S1.2: steps=33000, batch=1792, visual_multiscale=True
- S2: steps=6000, batch=3520, max_patches=24576, visual_multiscale=True
- head_dim check: 1792/28 = 64 ✓, 4096/32 = 128 ✓

```yaml
## configs/navil_9b.yaml

model:
  model_size: "9b"
  visual_encoder:
    depth: 32
    width: 1792
    mlp_width: 7168
    num_heads: 28
    patch_size: 16
    num_params: "1.2B"
  connector:
    pixel_shuffle_factor: 2
  llm:
    name_or_path: "Qwen/Qwen3-8B"
    depth: 36
    width: 4096
    mlp_width: 12288
    num_heads: 32
    num_experts: 2
    activated_params: "8.0B"
  total_params: "9.2B"
  activated_params: "9.2B"

inference:
  tau: 0.7071067811865476  ## sqrt(2)/2, downsampling rate for visual multi-scale packing
  min_area_threshold: 256  ## stop downsampling when area < patch_size^2 = 16*16
  llm_max_seq_length: 16384
  precision: "bfloat16"
  patch_size: 16
  image_pad_multiple: 32   ## pad H and W to multiples of 32

training:
  ## Stage 1.1: Multi-modal Generative Pre-training (web-scale noisy data)
  ## Visual multi-scale packing DISABLED for training acceleration (NaViL-9B specific)
  ## Trainable: visual encoder, MLP connector, MoE visual experts only
  ## Frozen: all LLM text parameters
  s1_1:
    steps: 50000
    global_batch_size: 10300
    peak_lr: 5.0e-5
    weight_decay: 0.05
    lr_schedule: "constant_warmup"
    warmup_steps: 200
    max_image_patches: 4096
    visual_multiscale_packing: false   ## disabled in S1.1 for NaViL-9B acceleration
    trainable_modules:
      - "visual_encoder"
      - "connector"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.visual_expert"
    frozen_modules:
      - "llm.embed_tokens"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert"
      - "llm.norm"
      - "llm.lm_head"
    data:
      total_samples: 500000000
      sources:
        - name: "laion2b"
          type: "webdataset"
          weight: 0.30
          caption_field: "txt"
        - name: "coyo700m"
          type: "webdataset"
          weight: 0.20
          caption_field: "caption"
        - name: "wukong"
          type: "webdataset"
          weight: 0.05
          caption_field: "caption"
        - name: "sa1b"
          type: "webdataset"
          weight: 0.05
          caption_field: "caption"
        - name: "synthetic_internvl8b"
          type: "webdataset"
          weight: 0.40
          caption_field: "caption"

  ## Stage 1.2: Multi-modal Generative Pre-training (high-quality alignment data)
  ## Visual multi-scale packing ENABLED from S1.2 onwards
  ## Trainable: visual encoder, MLP connector, ALL MoE experts including text self-attention
  ## Frozen: nothing (text self-attention layers also unfrozen)
  s1_2:
    steps: 33000
    global_batch_size: 1792
    peak_lr: 5.0e-5
    weight_decay: 0.1
    lr_schedule: "constant_warmup"
    warmup_steps: 200
    max_image_patches: 1218
    visual_multiscale_packing: true
    trainable_modules:
      - "visual_encoder"
      - "connector"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.visual_expert"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.q_proj"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.k_proj"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.v_proj"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.o_proj"
    frozen_modules:
      - "llm.embed_tokens"
      - "llm.norm"
      - "llm.lm_head"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.gate_proj"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.up_proj"
      - "llm.moe_layers.*.linguistic_expert.down_proj"
    data:
      total_samples: 185000000
      sources:
        - name: "internvl25_hq_multimodal"
          type: "jsonl"
          weight: 0.80
          ## Domains: image captioning, general QA, multi-turn dialogue,
          ## charts, OCR, documents, knowledge
        - name: "internlm25_pure_language"
          type: "jsonl"
          weight: 0.20

  ## Stage 2: Supervised Fine-tuning
  ## All parameters unfrozen
  ## max_image_patches significantly increased to 24576 for NaViL-9B
  s2:
    steps: 6000
    global_batch_size: 3520
    peak_lr: 2.0e-5
    weight_decay: 0.01
    lr_schedule: "cosine"
    warmup_steps: 200
    max_image_patches: 24576
    visual_multiscale_packing: true
    trainable_modules:
      - "all"
    frozen_modules: []
    data:
      total_samples: 68000000
      sources:
        - name: "internvl25_sft_hq"
          type: "jsonl"
          weight: 1.0
          ## Domains: image captioning, general QA, multi-turn dialogue,
          ## charts, OCR, documents, knowledge

  ## Shared optimizer settings across all stages
  optimizer:
    type: "AdamW"
    beta1: 0.9
    beta2: 0.95
    eps: 1.0e-8
    gradient_accumulation_steps: 1
    max_grad_norm: 1.0

  precision: "bfloat16"

data:
  paths:
    laion2b: "/data/laion2b"
    coyo700m: "/data/coyo700m"
    wukong: "/data/wukong"
    sa1b: "/data/sa1b"
    synthetic_internvl8b: "/data/synthetic_captions"
    internvl25_hq_multimodal: "/data/internvl25_hq"
    internlm25_pure_language: "/data/internlm25_text"
    internvl25_sft_hq: "/data/internvl25_sft"
  num_workers: 8
  pin_memory: true

evaluation:
  benchmarks:
    ## MLLM benchmarks (Table 4)
    - name: "mmvet"
      metric: "score"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "mmmu"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "val"
    - name: "mmbench_en"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "mme"
      metric: "sum"           ## perception + cognition scores summed
      max_value: 5000
      split: "full"
    - name: "mathvista_mini"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "ocrbench"
      metric: "score"
      max_value: 1000
      split: "test"
    - name: "ccbench"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    ## VQA benchmarks (Table 4)
    - name: "textvqa"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "val"
    - name: "scienceqa_img"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "gqa"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test_dev"
    - name: "docvqa"
      metric: "anls"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "ai2d"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "chartqa"
      metric: "relaxed_accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "infographicvqa"
      metric: "anls"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    ## NLP benchmarks (Table 5)
    - name: "mmlu"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "cmmlu"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
    - name: "math"
      metric: "accuracy"
      max_value: 100
      split: "test"
  max_new_tokens: 512
  decoding: "greedy"
  output_dir: "results/navil_9b"

output:
  checkpoint_dir: "checkpoints/navil_9b"
  max_checkpoints: 3
  save_every_steps: 5000
  log_every_steps: 100
  log_dir: "logs/navil_9b"

ablation:
  ## Settings for design-space experiments (Sec 3.2 and 3.3)
  ## All ablation models use InternLM2-Base as LLM unless testing LLM init
  base_llm: "internlm/internlm2-1_8b"
  fixed_visual_encoder_params: "600M"  ## fixed encoder size for LLM/MoE ablations
  fixed_llm_size: "1.8B"              ## fixed LLM size for encoder ablations

  ## Experiment 1: LLM initialization (Sec 3.2.1)
  llm_init:
    conditions:
      - name: "initialized"
        llm_init: "pretrained"
        llm_path: "internlm/internlm2-1_8b"
      - name: "from_scratch"
        llm_init: "random"
        llm_path: null
    metrics:
      - "validation_loss"
      - "zero_shot_captioning_cider"

  ## Experiment 2: MoE effectiveness (Sec 3.2.2)
  moe_ablation:
    conditions:
      - name: "with_moe"
        use_moe: true
        moe_type: "mha_and_ffn"   ## both MHA-MMoE and FFN-MMoE
      - name: "without_moe"
        use_moe: false
    metrics:
      - "validation_loss"

  ## Experiment 3: Visual encoder depth/width (Sec 3.2.3)
  ## Fixed total encoder params ~600M, vary depth and width
  encoder_architecture:
    total_params: "600M"
    configurations:
      - depth: 3
        width: 4096
      - depth: 6
        width: 2880
      - depth: 12
        width: 2048
      - depth: 24
        width: 1472
      - depth: 48
        width: 1024
    metrics:
      - "validation_loss"
      - "zero_shot_captioning_cider"

  ## Experiment 4 & 5: Independent scaling (Sec 3.3.1)
  llm_scaling:
    fixed_encoder_size: "600M"
    llm_sizes:
      - "0.5B"
      - "1.8B"
      - "7B"
    metrics:
      - "validation_loss"

  encoder_scaling:
    llm_sizes:
      - "0.5B"
      - "1.8B"
      - "7B"
    encoder_sizes:
      - "75M"
      - "150M"
      - "300M"
      - "600M"
      - "1.2B"
      - "2.4B"
    metrics:
      - "validation_loss"

  ## Experiment 6: Joint scaling optimal encoder size (Sec 3.3.2)
  ## Optimal encoder = smallest encoder where loss diff vs 2x larger < lambda
  joint_scaling:
    lambda_threshold: 0.01   ## 1% of loss with 75M encoder
    reference_encoder_size: "75M"
    metrics:
      - "optimal_encoder_size_per_llm"
```
